scenario: A real estate agent uses CMA tooling to help a seller price their home for listing. The workflow runs a comparative market analysis on the subject property against recent comps, computes a recommended list price from the CMA output using a financial calculator, and produces a polished seller-facing listing proposal document.
info_flow: idx-cma-report ingests subject property and comps to compute a central valuation estimate and range → financial-calculator takes the central estimate and applies a market appreciation markup to produce a recommended list price → reporting formats the result into a seller-facing listing proposal with the recommended price prominently displayed.
